user.title: Connect to Crafty Controller
user.description: Enter where Home Assistant can reach your Crafty Controller 4 panel.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the machine running Crafty, without https:// (for example crafty.local).
data_description.port: The HTTPS port of the Crafty web panel. Crafty uses 8443 unless you changed it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for Crafty's default self-signed certificate. Turn on only if Crafty has a certificate Home Assistant trusts.
data_description.auth_method: Log in with a Crafty username and password, or paste an API token created in Crafty.

data_description.username: A Crafty user that can see the servers you want to monitor.
data_description.password: The password for that user. It is stored in Home Assistant and used to get a fresh token when the old one expires.

data_description.token: In Crafty, open your user (Panel → Users → your user → API Keys), create a key with the permissions you need, and paste the token here.

servers.title: Choose servers
servers.description: Crafty reports {count} server(s) this account can access. Pick the ones to add to Home Assistant. You can change this later under Configure → Servers.

data_description.servers: Each selected server becomes a device with sensors, binary sensors and buttons.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Crafty
reauth_confirm.description: Crafty at {host} rejected the stored login. Enter new details to keep your entities working.

data_description.username: A Crafty user that can see the servers you want to monitor.
data_description.password: The password for that user. It is stored in Home Assistant and used to get a fresh token when the old one expires.
data_description.token: In Crafty, open your user (Panel → Users → your user → API Keys), create a key with the permissions you need, and paste the token here.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Crafty connection
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant connects to Crafty. Devices, entity IDs and history are kept.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the machine running Crafty, without https:// (for example crafty.local).
data_description.port: The HTTPS port of the Crafty web panel. Crafty uses 8443 unless you changed it.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for Crafty's default self-signed certificate. Turn on only if Crafty has a certificate Home Assistant trusts.
data_description.auth_method: Log in with a Crafty username and password, or paste an API token created in Crafty.

reconfigure_credentials.title: Crafty login
reconfigure_credentials.description: Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

data_description.username: A Crafty user that can see the servers you want to monitor.
data_description.password: The password for that user. It is stored in Home Assistant and used to get a fresh token when the old one expires.

reconfigure_token.title: Crafty API token
reconfigure_token.description: Leave empty to keep the stored token.

data_description.token: In Crafty, open your user (Panel → Users → your user → API Keys), create a key with the permissions you need, and paste the token here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Crafty. Check the host and port, that Crafty is running, and that Home Assistant can reach it on your network.
error.invalid_auth: Crafty rejected the login or token.
error.already_configured: Another Crafty entry already uses this host and port.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Crafty instance is already configured.

init.title: Crafty Controller options
init.description: Pick a section. Saving a section applies it immediately.

data.retry_on_403: Log in again when the token expires

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch server stats (10–300 seconds).
data_description.timeout: How long to wait for Crafty before a request fails (5–60 seconds).
data_description.retry_on_403: With username/password login, transparently log in again and retry once when Crafty answers 403.
data_description.unreachable_minutes: Create a repair issue when Crafty has been unreachable this long.

servers.title: Servers
servers.description: The list is fetched from Crafty each time you open this step, so new servers appear here. Unselecting a server removes its device and entities.

data.allow_console_server: Allow console commands for this server

data_description.name_override: Leave empty to use the name from Crafty.
data_description.enabled_entities: Unticked entities are disabled (not deleted), so their history is kept. New servers start with only Running and the Start, Stop and Restart buttons.
data_description.server_scan_interval: Seconds between polls for this server. 0 uses the general poll interval.
data_description.allow_console_server: Also requires 'Allow console commands' in Safety.

data_description.allow_kill: Kill ends the Java process immediately and can corrupt the world. Off by default.
data_description.allow_stop_restart: Lets buttons, services and scheduled tasks stop or restart servers.
data_description.allow_console: Lets the send_command service and command tasks run console commands.

events.title: Events
events.description: Fire these events on the Home Assistant event bus by comparing consecutive polls. Short sessions between two polls can be missed.

data_description.enable_host_metrics: Reads /metrics/host. Needs a Crafty account with global access; it switches itself off if Crafty refuses.
data_description.debug_logging: Raises only this integration's log level to debug. Tokens and passwords are never logged.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Crafty to refresh the server list; showing the servers already configured.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.no_servers: No servers are monitored yet. Add one under Servers first.

invalid_auth.message: Crafty rejected the login or token. Re-authenticate the integration.

kill_blocked.message: Killing {server} is blocked. Turn on 'Allow kill server' in the Crafty Controller options (Safety).

stop_restart_blocked.message: Stopping or restarting {server} is blocked. Turn on 'Allow stop and restart' in the Crafty Controller options (Safety).

console_blocked.message: Console commands for {server} are blocked. Turn them on in the Crafty Controller options (Safety, and the server's own settings).

feature_disabled.message: The {feature} feature is turned off. Enable it in the Crafty Controller options (Advanced).

no_target.message: No monitored Crafty server matches the selected target.

command_required.message: A command is required when the task action is 'command'.

cron_required.message: A cron string is required when the interval type is 'cron'.

unreachable.title: Crafty Controller is unreachable
unreachable.description: Home Assistant has not been able to reach Crafty at {url} for {entry_title} for more than {minutes} minutes. Check that Crafty is running, the host and port are right (Reconfigure), and that Home Assistant's network can reach it. This issue clears itself once Crafty answers again.

auth_failed.title: Crafty Controller login failing
auth_failed.description: Crafty keeps rejecting the login for {entry_title}. Open Settings → Devices & services → Crafty Controller and re-authenticate, or create a new API token in Crafty.

server_not_found.title: Crafty server not found
server_not_found.description: The server {server} on {entry_title} is no longer available to this account (it was deleted or permissions changed). Its entities are unavailable. Remove it under Configure → Servers if it is gone for good.

new_servers.title: New Crafty servers available
new_servers.description: Crafty on {entry_title} has servers that are not monitored yet: {servers}. To add them, open Settings → Devices & services → Crafty Controller → Configure → Servers.

send_command.name: Send console command
send_command.description: Sends a console command to Crafty servers. A leading slash is removed.

command.name: Command
command.description: The console command, for example 'say Hello' or 'whitelist add Steve'.

get_logs.name: Get logs
get_logs.description: Returns recent console log lines. Requires 'Log service' in Advanced options.

lines.name: Lines
lines.description: How many of the most recent lines to return.

from_file.name: Read log file
from_file.description: Read latest.log instead of Crafty's console buffer.

create_task.name: Create scheduled task
create_task.description: Creates a Crafty schedule. Requires 'Scheduled task services' in Advanced options.

command.name: Command
command.description: Console command, used when the action is 'command'.

interval.name: Interval
interval.description: Run every N units of the interval type.

interval_type.name: Interval type
interval_type.description: Unit for the interval, 'reaction' to chain after another task, or 'cron' to use the cron string.

cron_string.name: Cron string
cron_string.description: Cron expression, used when the interval type is 'cron'.

one_time.name: One time
one_time.description: Delete the schedule after it runs once.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds to wait before running (for reaction tasks).

set_task_enabled.name: Enable or disable scheduled task
set_task_enabled.description: Enables or disables a Crafty schedule.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the schedule on or off.

list_webhooks.name: List webhooks
list_webhooks.description: Returns the webhooks configured on Crafty servers. Requires 'Webhook services' in Advanced options.

webhook_type.name: Type
webhook_type.description: Which service the webhook posts to.

triggers.name: Triggers
triggers.description: Crafty events that fire the webhook.
